newsitem.title: THAILAND: U.S., Thailand reach agreement on tax treaty.
newsitem.headline: U.S., Thailand reach agreement on tax treaty.

text.p: Thailand and the United States have ended 14 years of negotiations and reached an agreement on a tax treaty, a U.S. Embassy official said on Monday.
David Moran, Economic Affairs Counsellor at the Embassy, said the treaty must be approved by both governments before being signed and implemented.
"The text is confidential until it is reviewed," Moran told Reuters, refusing to give details of the treaty, which helps investors avoid being taxed in both countries.
The major stumbling blocks in the negotiations had to do with information exchange between the two countries and how they would tax leased ships or containers.
Thai and U.S. officials hope the treaty will be signed by November.
